FULL changes, including small fluid/floor changes, are observed separately and bounded; decorated underground blocks are NOT claimed identical. A/A controls measure native repeat variability without automatically subtracting it.
implementation: Shared seeded 2-D entrance gate, shallow noise blend and per-invocation native carver-output guard; no loaded-world edits, no changed native start probabilities or random draws
depth_scope: Noise cave influence returns exactly to old weight from 42 blocks below envelope; carver proposals at least 14 blocks below envelope are passed through
limitations: Finite fixed-coordinate sample, not proof for every seed
Opening area is a vertical dry surface-cut proxy, not exact cave count or all side entrances
Upper cave branches can close or change connectivity; an accessible entrance for every deep chamber is not guaranteed
FULL decoration can change ores, sculk, plants and small cave-floor water patches; all sampled raw changes are retained
Structures keep native placement definitions; local suitability and decorations near repaired holes can change
Existing chunks are not repaired automatically; old/new boundaries may differ
Client visuals, full user modpack, Distant Horizons and C2ME not tested
Village door/pathfinding findings remain in raw audit
